trigger.failure: On the first Intermedio repetition, LlamaCode correctly suppressed the already-completed identical workload. The external runner treated the app's explicit skipped status as an error and exited nonzero; systemd then cleaned up the isolated app and model. OOM counters were zero. This was a runner/protocol mismatch, not an app crash or memory failure.

change.task_metadata_ids: Append _q181_repeat_02 or _q181_repeat_03 to the fixture task IDs so each registered repetition has a distinct app evaluation fingerprint.

rationale: App evaluation fingerprints include task IDs and deliberately suppress identical completed evaluations. Unique IDs are metadata labels for repeated runs; the model receives the exact same prompts and deterministic acceptance oracles. Pass 1 is preserved and passes 2–3 resume against the same isolated profiles.
resource_policy: One Q181 systemd service only, both GPUs in series, no artificial RAM/swap cap; preserve the preregistered OOM/Xid, port, isolation and 1200-second readiness gates.
stop_if: duplicate guard still suppresses a pass
